== Notes ==
* This enchantment can be kept up by using skills with a short recharge and low energy cost such as [[Wastrel's Worry]] and [[Wastrel's Demise]].
*The skill reapplies itself before new enchantments are applied (from the likes of [[Magnetic Surge]] or [[Ice Spear]]), so those will [[cover]] Lyssa's Aura.
